name: Epic Infested Armor
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Infested Armor

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Fortification
effects.tooltip: Fortification +111% : +111% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Greater Disease Guard
effects.tooltip: Greater Disease Guard : This item carries the Maggot Plague disease, which deals 2d6 Constitution damage and may be contracted by enemies that hit you. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 28) will negate this effect.

effects.name: Sheltering
effects.tooltip: Sheltering +24 : +24 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings

effects.name: Demonic Shield
effects.tooltip: Demonic Shield : Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +30 Profane bonus to temporary hit points .

effects.name: DR 15/Good
effects.tooltip: Damage Reduction 15/Good : Reduces physical damage by 15, except from Good attacks.

effects.name: Spell Resistance
effects.tooltip: Spell Resistance +28: +28 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance .

flavor_text: An orthon warrior's body is crawling with hungry maggots that feed on its wounds. This suit of armor, crafted from the salvaged parts of an orthon's protective gear, is similarly infested and may impart a disease to those that attack the wearer.
